title: POV: you're dating a Sagittarius.
old_caption: Ask a Sagittarius and you get the honest answer. About your hat, their cooking, and how much they like you.

title: POV: you're dating a Capricorn.
old_caption: Your Capricorn arrives early with your coffee and a five-year plan for the houseplant. Year five? Still you.

title: POV: you're dating an Aquarius.
old_caption: An Aquarius won't buy you a gift. They'll build one that pours cocoa very slowly. Weird and sweet is the point.

title: POV: you're dating a Pisces.
old_caption: Dating a Pisces: tears at the trailer, tears over one shared fry, and the tissues ready when you cry too.

title: POV: you're dating an Aries. Snow day.
old_caption: An Aries builds a snowman in four seconds. Then builds a little one for you and waits while you add the nose.

title: POV: you're dating a Taurus. Holiday market.
old_caption: Take a Taurus to a holiday market and they'll taste every sample. Mention the one you liked and they buy the box.

title: POV: you're dating a Gemini. The holiday party.
old_caption: Your Gemini knows everyone at the party. Their favourite conversation of the night is still the quiet one with you.

title: POV: you're dating a Cancer. The ornament.
old_caption: A Cancer hands you a slightly lopsided ornament they made. Then shows you its twin, already hanging on their family's tree.

title: POV: you're dating a Leo. The lights.
old_caption: Date a Leo in December and the house lights get very bright. Then they rearrange to spell one word: YOU.

title: POV: you're dating a Virgo. Gift wrap.
old_caption: A Virgo wraps gifts with perfect corners. Yours came out lumpy, so they put it on the shelf like a piece of art.
